events.title: 1st Test - Day 1 - 19 Nov 2026
events.synopsis: With white-ball honors secured, India now shift their focus to the longest format as they take on New Zealand in the 1st Test of the India Tour of New Zealand 2026. Having won both the T20I and ODI series, India will look to carry their winning momentum into the two-match Test series, while New Zealand aim to bounce back. Can India continue their dominance or will the hosts turn things around? Watch Day 1 LIVE, only on Sony LIV.
